characterList.description: A young man with short dark hair, wearing a blue t-shirt and headphones. He sits in front of a computer screen in a room with pink and purple lighting.
characterList.name: Presenter

content_metadata.description: A tutorial video guiding viewers through the process of setting up a speedrun timer using LiveSplit and integrating it with OBS.

qAndA.question: What color does the LiveSplit timer turn when a speedrun is completed?

qAndA.answer: The website link is provided in the video description.
qAndA.question: What website should viewers visit to download LiveSplit?
What hotkey does the presenter suggest using for the undo split function?

qAndA.answer: Green screen filters in OBS might affect the transparency, potentially hiding the icons.
qAndA.question: What potential issue does the presenter highlight regarding the transparent background for LiveSplit?

activities.description: Presenter introduces himself and the purpose of the video (how to set up a speedrun timer using LiveSplit)

mood.description: Excited - The presenter's fast-paced speech, energetic tone, and the colorful background contribute to the excitement of the introduction.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction to the topic of setting up a speedrun timer.

activities.description: Presenter directs viewers to download LiveSplit from the link in the description.
Presenter demonstrates how to create a new folder and extract the downloaded files.

mood.description: Calm, Informative - The presenter's calmer tone and clear instructions create a more informative and relaxed atmosphere.

narrativeProgression.description: Steps for downloading and extracting LiveSplit files.

activities.description: Presenter opens LiveSplit and demonstrates how to access the edit splits section.
Presenter explains how to add a game, category, and splits to LiveSplit.
Presenter explains how to add icons to splits and provides his Discord information for viewers to request his icons.
Presenter explains how to adjust the layout of LiveSplit and reduce unnecessary space.
Presenter explains how to add additional components to the LiveSplit layout, including a detailed timer and sound effects.

mood.description: Calm, Informative - The presenter continues to provide clear, step-by-step instructions in a calm and informative manner.

narrativeProgression.description: Detailed explanation of setting up LiveSplit, adding splits, adjusting the layout, and adding extra features.

activities.description: Presenter explains how to access the LiveSplit settings and hotkey settings.
Presenter demonstrates how to change hotkeys for starting, resetting, and undoing splits.
Presenter advises choosing uncommon keys for hotkeys and emphasizes the importance of enabling 'Global hotkeys.'

mood.description: Calm, Informative - The presenter maintains a calm and informative tone while explaining hotkey setup.

narrativeProgression.description: Instructions on setting hotkeys for key speedrunning functions and enabling global hotkeys.

activities.description: Presenter explains the significance of different colors in the LiveSplit timer (blue for completed run).
Presenter discusses the color coding for personal best comparisons (red for slower, gold for golden splits, green for ahead of PB).

mood.description: Calm, Informative - The presenter effectively explains the meaning of various colors in a clear and concise manner.

narrativeProgression.description: Explanation of how LiveSplit timer colors indicate speedrun progress and personal best comparisons.

activities.description: Presenter demonstrates how to add the LiveSplit window to an OBS scene using Window Capture.
Presenter emphasizes the importance of selecting the correct window (with 'LiveSplit' in the title) and explains how resizing the LiveSplit window on the desktop also resizes it in OBS.

mood.description: Calm, Informative - The presenter efficiently guides viewers through the process of adding LiveSplit to OBS.

narrativeProgression.description: Steps for incorporating LiveSplit into OBS for stream display.

activities.description: Presenter explains a workaround for making LiveSplit transparent in OBS by changing the background color in LiveSplit settings.
Presenter demonstrates adjusting the background color and opacity for different sections of the LiveSplit layout.
Presenter explains the issue of green screen filters potentially affecting transparent elements in LiveSplit.

mood.description: Calm, Informative - The presenter provides a solution for transparency, addresses potential issues, and maintains an informative tone.

narrativeProgression.description: Workaround for achieving LiveSplit transparency in OBS and a cautionary note about potential color conflicts with green screen filters.

props.name: LiveSplit settings interface and OBS interface.

activities.description: Presenter instructs viewers to save their LiveSplit settings (both splits and layout) to preserve their configurations.
Presenter concludes the tutorial, encourages viewers to engage with the video (like, comment, subscribe), and promotes his Twitch and YouTube channels.

mood.description: Happy - The presenter expresses satisfaction with completing the tutorial and uses a friendly, encouraging tone to interact with viewers.

narrativeProgression.description: Final steps for saving LiveSplit settings and a concluding message to the audience.

climax.description: Scene 8 (6:25) when the presenter successfully completes the tutorial.

storylines.description: Informational guide on setting up a speedrun timer using LiveSplit and integrating it with OBS.

content_metadata.title: Setting up LiveSplit for Speedrunning and Integrating with OBS

trimmingSuggestions.description: The explanation of speedrun timer colors could be slightly condensed to maintain a faster pace.
The demonstration of changing the background color and opacity could be shortened as it's mostly repetitive.

youtube_description:
I will show you how to setup a transparent timer , normal timer , splits , definitions for different coloured numbers and how to bring the timer into OBS.

I've had a bunch of people recently ask me about how to set up LiveSplit for Minecraft so I figured I'd make a comprehensive video tutorial to answer all of the frequently asked questions. This tutorial can be used for other speedruns not just minecraft but i used minecraft as a reference point for this tutorial.

I will show you how to setup a transparent timer , normal timer , splits , definitions for different coloured numbers and how to bring the timer into OBS.

LiveSplit Download: http://livesplit.org/downloads/

I Speedrun on Twitch! https://twitch.tv/LiquidCandyy
